#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <math_constants.h>

#define DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define N_TOK 16
#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define WINS_PER_BLOCK 4

__device__ inline float gelu(float x) {
    return 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erff(x * 0.7071067811865475f));
}

__constant__ __half c_norm1_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm1_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half2 c_qkv_w_h2[3*DIM*DIM/2];
__constant__ __half c_qkv_b[3*DIM];
__constant__ __half2 c_proj_w_h2[DIM*DIM/2];
__constant__ __half c_proj_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm2_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half2 c_fc1_w_h2[HIDDEN*DIM/2];
__constant__ __half c_fc1_b[HIDDEN];
__constant__ __half2 c_fc2_w_h2[DIM*HIDDEN/2];
__constant__ __half c_fc2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_rpe_bias[N_TOK*N_TOK];

struct WinSmem {
    __half resid[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half ln1[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half qkv[N_TOK*3*DIM];
    __half attn[N_TOK*N_TOK];
    __half attno[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half hidden[N_TOK*HIDDEN];
};

__global__ void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int tid = threadIdx.x;
    int tok = tid >> 2;
    int cg = tid & 3;
    int c_base = cg * 8;

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln1   = sm->ln1;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;

    int ty = tok >> 2;
    int tx = tok & 3;
    int h_idx = wh * WH + ty;
    int w_idx = ww * WW + tx;
    const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;

    {
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    unsigned mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    // LayerNorm 1
    {
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        float2 v0 = __half22float2(row[0]);
        float2 v1 = __half22float2(row[1]);
        float2 v2 = __half22float2(row[2]);
        float2 v3 = __half22float2(row[3]);
        float local_sum = v0.x+v0.y+v1.x+v1.y+v2.x+v2.y+v3.x+v3.y;
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 1);
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 2);
        float mean = local_sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);

        float dv0x=v0.x-mean,dv0y=v0.y-mean,dv1x=v1.x-mean,dv1y=v1.y-mean;
        float dv2x=v2.x-mean,dv2y=v2.y-mean,dv3x=v3.x-mean,dv3y=v3.y-mean;
        float local_sq = dv0x*dv0x+dv0y*dv0y+dv1x*dv1x+dv1y*dv1y+dv2x*dv2x+dv2y*dv2y+dv3x*dv3x+dv3y*dv3y;
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 1);
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 2);
        float invstd = rsqrtf(local_sq * (1.0f/(float)DIM) + 1e-5f);

        if (cg == 0) {
            s_mean[wlocal][tok] = mean;
            s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    {
        float mean = s_mean[wlocal][tok];
        float invstd = s_invstd[wlocal][tok];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float v = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + c]);
            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[c]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[c]);
            float out = (v - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln1[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(out);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // QKV: each thread computes 24 output channels using half2 dot products
    {
        int oc_per = 24;
        int oc_start = cg * oc_per;
        __half2 ln_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* ln_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_ln1[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) ln_h2[k] = ln_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int oo = 0; oo < oc_per; oo++) {
            int oc = oc_start + oo;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_qkv_w_h2[oc * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(ln_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_qkv_b[oc]);
            sh_qkv[tok * (3*DIM) + oc] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)DIM);
    {
        int entries_per = 4;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int e = 0; e < entries_per; e++) {
            int idx = tid * entries_per + e;
            int i = idx / N_TOK;
            int j = idx % N_TOK;
            const __half2* qrow = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_qkv[i * (3*DIM) + 0*DIM]);
            const __half2* krow = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_qkv[j * (3*DIM) + 1*DIM]);
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(qrow[k], krow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2)));
            acc *= scale;
            acc += __half2float(c_rpe_bias[i * N_TOK + j]);
            sh_attn[i * N_TOK + j] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    {
        int col_start = cg * 4;
        float vals[4];
        float local_max = -CUDART_INF_F;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            vals[k] = __half2float(sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + col_start + k]);
            local_max = fmaxf(local_max, vals[k]);
        }
        float m = local_max;
        m = fmaxf(m, __shfl_xor_sync(mask, m, 1));
        m = fmaxf(m, __shfl_xor_sync(mask, m, 2));

        float local_sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            vals[k] = __expf(vals[k] - m);
            local_sum += vals[k];
        }
        float s = local_sum;
        s += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, s, 1);
        s += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, s, 2);
        float inv_s = 1.0f / s;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + col_start + k] = __float2half(vals[k] * inv_s);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // attn @ V
    {
        __half a_row[N_TOK];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) a_row[j] = sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + j];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float acc = 0.f;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                acc += __half2float(a_row[j]) * __half2float(sh_qkv[j * (3*DIM) + 2*DIM + c]);
            }
            sh_attno[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // proj
    {
        __half2 in_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* in_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_attno[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) in_h2[k] = in_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int oc = c_base + i;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_proj_w_h2[oc * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(in_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_proj_b[oc]);
            float r = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc]);
            sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc] = __float2half(acc + r);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // LayerNorm 2
    {
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        float2 v0 = __half22float2(row[0]);
        float2 v1 = __half22float2(row[1]);
        float2 v2 = __half22float2(row[2]);
        float2 v3 = __half22float2(row[3]);
        float local_sum = v0.x+v0.y+v1.x+v1.y+v2.x+v2.y+v3.x+v3.y;
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 1);
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 2);
        float mean = local_sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);

        float dv0x=v0.x-mean,dv0y=v0.y-mean,dv1x=v1.x-mean,dv1y=v1.y-mean;
        float dv2x=v2.x-mean,dv2y=v2.y-mean,dv3x=v3.x-mean,dv3y=v3.y-mean;
        float local_sq = dv0x*dv0x+dv0y*dv0y+dv1x*dv1x+dv1y*dv1y+dv2x*dv2x+dv2y*dv2y+dv3x*dv3x+dv3y*dv3y;
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 1);
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 2);
        float invstd = rsqrtf(local_sq * (1.0f/(float)DIM) + 1e-5f);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float v = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + c]);
            float w = __half2float(c_norm2_w[c]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm2_b[c]);
            float out = (v - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln1[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(out);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC1
    {
        int h_per = HIDDEN / 4;
        int h_start = cg * h_per;
        __half2 ln_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* ln_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_ln1[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) ln_h2[k] = ln_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int hh = 0; hh < h_per; hh++) {
            int h = h_start + hh;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_fc1_w_h2[h * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(ln_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_fc1_b[h]);
            float g = gelu(acc);
            sh_hidden[tok * HIDDEN + h] = __float2half(g);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC2
    {
        __half* out_ptr = x_out + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        __half result[8];
        const __half2* hid_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_hidden[tok * HIDDEN]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int oc = c_base + i;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_fc2_w_h2[oc * (HIDDEN/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < HIDDEN/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(hid_row[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_fc2_b[oc]);
            float r = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc]);
            result[i] = __float2half(acc + r);
        }
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(out_ptr + c_base) = *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(result);
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    const __half* norm1_w, const __half* norm1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* norm2_w, const __half* norm2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    __half* out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_w, norm1_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_b, norm1_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_w_h2, qkv_w, 3*DIM*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_b, qkv_b, 3*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_w_h2, proj_w, DIM*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_b, proj_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_w, norm2_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_b, norm2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc1_w_h2, fc1_w, HIDDEN*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc1_b, fc1_b, HIDDEN*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc2_w_h2, fc2_w, DIM*HIDDEN*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc2_b, fc2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_rpe_bias, rpe_bias, N_TOK*N_TOK*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);

    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = B * nH * nW;
    int num_blocks = (num_windows + WINS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WINS_PER_BLOCK;

    dim3 grid(num_blocks);
    dim3 block(64, WINS_PER_BLOCK);

    size_t smem_bytes = WINS_PER_BLOCK * sizeof(WinSmem);

    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, smem_bytes, stream>>>(
        x, out, B, H, W, C, nH, nW);
}

#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <ATen/cuda/CUDAContext.h>
#include <c10/cuda/CUDAStream.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <vector>
#include "kernel.h"

static torch::Tensor g_rpe_bias;
static torch::Tensor g_norm1_w, g_norm1_b;
static torch::Tensor g_qkv_w, g_qkv_b;
static torch::Tensor g_proj_w, g_proj_b;
static torch::Tensor g_norm2_w, g_norm2_b;
static torch::Tensor g_fc1_w, g_fc1_b;
static torch::Tensor g_fc2_w, g_fc2_b;

static torch::Tensor to_half_cuda(torch::Tensor t) {
    if (!t.is_cuda()) t = t.cuda();
    if (t.scalar_type() != torch::kHalf) t = t.to(torch::kHalf);
    return t.contiguous();
}

void set_params(
    torch::Tensor rpe_bias,
    torch::Tensor norm1_w, torch::Tensor norm1_b,
    torch::Tensor qkv_w, torch::Tensor qkv_b,
    torch::Tensor proj_w, torch::Tensor proj_b,
    torch::Tensor norm2_w, torch::Tensor norm2_b,
    torch::Tensor fc1_w, torch::Tensor fc1_b,
    torch::Tensor fc2_w, torch::Tensor fc2_b)
{
    g_rpe_bias = to_half_cuda(rpe_bias);
    g_norm1_w = to_half_cuda(norm1_w);
    g_norm1_b = to_half_cuda(norm1_b);
    g_qkv_w = to_half_cuda(qkv_w);
    g_qkv_b = to_half_cuda(qkv_b);
    g_proj_w = to_half_cuda(proj_w);
    g_proj_b = to_half_cuda(proj_b);
    g_norm2_w = to_half_cuda(norm2_w);
    g_norm2_b = to_half_cuda(norm2_b);
    g_fc1_w = to_half_cuda(fc1_w);
    g_fc1_b = to_half_cuda(fc1_b);
    g_fc2_w = to_half_cuda(fc2_w);
    g_fc2_b = to_half_cuda(fc2_b);
}

std::vector<torch::Tensor> run(torch::Tensor x) {
    TORCH_CHECK(x.is_cuda(), "input must be CUDA");
    if (x.scalar_type() != torch::kHalf) x = x.to(torch::kHalf);
    x = x.contiguous();

    int B = x.size(0);
    int H = x.size(1);
    int W = x.size(2);
    int C = x.size(3);

    auto out = torch::empty_like(x);

    cudaStream_t stream = c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();

    launch_swin_block(
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(x.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm1_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm1_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_qkv_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_qkv_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_proj_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_proj_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm2_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm2_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc1_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc1_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc2_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc2_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_rpe_bias.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<__half*>(out.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        B, H, W, C, stream);

    return {out};
}

PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, m) {
    m.def("run", &run, "Run fused Swin block");
    m.def("set_params", &set_params, "Set model parameters");

#define N_TOK 16

#define WW 4
#define WINS_PER_BLOCK 4

__constant__ __half c_norm2_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half2 c_fc1_w_h2[HIDDEN*DIM/2];
__constant__ __half c_fc1_b[HIDDEN];
__constant__ __half2 c_fc2_w_h2[DIM*HIDDEN/2];
__constant__ __half c_fc2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_rpe_bias[N_TOK*N_TOK];

struct WinSmem {
    __half resid[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half ln1[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half qkv[N_TOK*3*DIM];
    __half attn[N_TOK*N_TOK];
    __half attno[N_TOK*DIM];
    __half hidden[N_TOK*HIDDEN];
};

__global__ void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int tid = threadIdx.x;
    int tok = tid >> 2;
    int cg = tid & 3;
    int c_base = cg * 8;

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln1   = sm->ln1;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;

    int ty = tok >> 2;
    int tx = tok & 3;
    int h_idx = wh * WH + ty;
    int w_idx = ww * WW + tx;
    const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;

    {
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    unsigned mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    // LayerNorm 1
    {
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        float2 v0 = __half22float2(row[0]);
        float2 v1 = __half22float2(row[1]);
        float2 v2 = __half22float2(row[2]);
        float2 v3 = __half22float2(row[3]);
        float local_sum = v0.x+v0.y+v1.x+v1.y+v2.x+v2.y+v3.x+v3.y;
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 1);
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 2);
        float mean = local_sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);

        float dv0x=v0.x-mean,dv0y=v0.y-mean,dv1x=v1.x-mean,dv1y=v1.y-mean;
        float dv2x=v2.x-mean,dv2y=v2.y-mean,dv3x=v3.x-mean,dv3y=v3.y-mean;
        float local_sq = dv0x*dv0x+dv0y*dv0y+dv1x*dv1x+dv1y*dv1y+dv2x*dv2x+dv2y*dv2y+dv3x*dv3x+dv3y*dv3y;
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 1);
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 2);
        float invstd = rsqrtf(local_sq * (1.0f/(float)DIM) + 1e-5f);

        if (cg == 0) {
            s_mean[wlocal][tok] = mean;
            s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    {
        float mean = s_mean[wlocal][tok];
        float invstd = s_invstd[wlocal][tok];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float v = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + c]);
            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[c]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[c]);
            float out = (v - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln1[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(out);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // QKV: each thread computes 24 output channels using half2 dot products
    {
        int oc_per = 24;
        int oc_start = cg * oc_per;
        __half2 ln_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* ln_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_ln1[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) ln_h2[k] = ln_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int oo = 0; oo < oc_per; oo++) {
            int oc = oc_start + oo;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_qkv_w_h2[oc * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(ln_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_qkv_b[oc]);
            sh_qkv[tok * (3*DIM) + oc] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)DIM);
    {
        int entries_per = 4;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int e = 0; e < entries_per; e++) {
            int idx = tid * entries_per + e;
            int i = idx / N_TOK;
            int j = idx % N_TOK;
            const __half2* qrow = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_qkv[i * (3*DIM) + 0*DIM]);
            const __half2* krow = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_qkv[j * (3*DIM) + 1*DIM]);
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(qrow[k], krow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2)));
            acc *= scale;
            acc += __half2float(c_rpe_bias[i * N_TOK + j]);
            sh_attn[i * N_TOK + j] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    {
        int col_start = cg * 4;
        float vals[4];
        float local_max = -CUDART_INF_F;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            vals[k] = __half2float(sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + col_start + k]);
            local_max = fmaxf(local_max, vals[k]);
        }
        float m = local_max;
        m = fmaxf(m, __shfl_xor_sync(mask, m, 1));
        m = fmaxf(m, __shfl_xor_sync(mask, m, 2));

        float local_sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            vals[k] = __expf(vals[k] - m);
            local_sum += vals[k];
        }
        float s = local_sum;
        s += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, s, 1);
        s += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, s, 2);
        float inv_s = 1.0f / s;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + col_start + k] = __float2half(vals[k] * inv_s);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // attn @ V
    {
        __half a_row[N_TOK];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) a_row[j] = sh_attn[tok * N_TOK + j];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float acc = 0.f;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                acc += __half2float(a_row[j]) * __half2float(sh_qkv[j * (3*DIM) + 2*DIM + c]);
            }
            sh_attno[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(acc);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // proj
    {
        __half2 in_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* in_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_attno[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) in_h2[k] = in_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int oc = c_base + i;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_proj_w_h2[oc * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(in_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_proj_b[oc]);
            float r = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc]);
            sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc] = __float2half(acc + r);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // LayerNorm 2
    {
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        float2 v0 = __half22float2(row[0]);
        float2 v1 = __half22float2(row[1]);
        float2 v2 = __half22float2(row[2]);
        float2 v3 = __half22float2(row[3]);
        float local_sum = v0.x+v0.y+v1.x+v1.y+v2.x+v2.y+v3.x+v3.y;
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 1);
        local_sum += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sum, 2);
        float mean = local_sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);

        float dv0x=v0.x-mean,dv0y=v0.y-mean,dv1x=v1.x-mean,dv1y=v1.y-mean;
        float dv2x=v2.x-mean,dv2y=v2.y-mean,dv3x=v3.x-mean,dv3y=v3.y-mean;
        float local_sq = dv0x*dv0x+dv0y*dv0y+dv1x*dv1x+dv1y*dv1y+dv2x*dv2x+dv2y*dv2y+dv3x*dv3x+dv3y*dv3y;
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 1);
        local_sq += __shfl_xor_sync(mask, local_sq, 2);
        float invstd = rsqrtf(local_sq * (1.0f/(float)DIM) + 1e-5f);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int c = c_base + i;
            float v = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + c]);
            float w = __half2float(c_norm2_w[c]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm2_b[c]);
            float out = (v - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln1[tok * DIM + c] = __float2half(out);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC1
    {
        int h_per = HIDDEN / 4;
        int h_start = cg * h_per;
        __half2 ln_h2[DIM/2];
        const __half2* ln_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_ln1[tok * DIM]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) ln_h2[k] = ln_row[k];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int hh = 0; hh < h_per; hh++) {
            int h = h_start + hh;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_fc1_w_h2[h * (DIM/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(ln_h2[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_fc1_b[h]);
            float g = gelu(acc);
            sh_hidden[tok * HIDDEN + h] = __float2half(g);
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC2
    {
        __half* out_ptr = x_out + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        __half result[8];
        const __half2* hid_row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_hidden[tok * HIDDEN]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int oc = c_base + i;
            const __half2* wrow = &c_fc2_w_h2[oc * (HIDDEN/2)];
            __half2 acc2 = __float2half2_rn(0.f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int k = 0; k < HIDDEN/2; k++) {
                acc2 = __hfma2(hid_row[k], wrow[k], acc2);
            }
            float acc = __half2float(__hadd(__low2half(acc2), __high2half(acc2))) + __half2float(c_fc2_b[oc]);
            float r = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + oc]);
            result[i] = __float2half(acc + r);
        }
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(out_ptr + c_base) = *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(result);
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    const __half* norm1_w, const __half* norm1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* norm2_w, const __half* norm2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    __half* out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_w, norm1_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_b, norm1_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_w_h2, qkv_w, 3*DIM*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_b, qkv_b, 3*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_w_h2, proj_w, DIM*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_b, proj_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_w, norm2_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_b, norm2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc1_w_h2, fc1_w, HIDDEN*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc1_b, fc1_b, HIDDEN*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc2_w_h2, fc2_w, DIM*HIDDEN*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc2_b, fc2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_rpe_bias, rpe_bias, N_TOK*N_TOK*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);

    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = B * nH * nW;
    int num_blocks = (num_windows + WINS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WINS_PER_BLOCK;

    dim3 grid(num_blocks);
    dim3 block(64, WINS_PER_BLOCK);

    size_t smem_bytes = WINS_PER_BLOCK * sizeof(WinSmem);

    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, smem_bytes, stream>>>(
        x, out, B, H, W, C, nH, nW);
}

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <mma.h>
#include <math_constants.h>

using namespace nvcuda;

#define DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define N_TOK 16
#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define WINS_PER_BLOCK 4

__device__ inline float gelu(float x) {
    return 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erff(x * 0.7071067811865475f));
}

__constant__ __half c_norm1_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm1_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_qkv_b[3*DIM];
__constant__ __half c_proj_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm2_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_fc1_b[HIDDEN];
__constant__ __half c_fc2_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_rpe_bias[N_TOK*N_TOK];

// We'll keep weight matrices in global memory and load via WMMA fragments.
// For best WMMA layout we'll store:
//   qkv_w as (3*DIM=96 rows, DIM=32 cols) row-major  -> we want C_out x C_in
//   For WMMA we need 16x16x16 tiles. We'll transpose-treat as needed.

// Layout choice for WMMA:
//   We compute Y[16,Cout] = X[16,Cin] @ W[Cin,Cout]
//   Using wmma::fragment<matrix_a, 16,16,16, half, row_major> for X (M x K)
//   Using wmma::fragment<matrix_b, 16,16,16, half, col_major> for W^T view, or row_major.
//   We'll store weights as col_major (i.e., W[Cin,Cout] in col-major == W^T[Cout,Cin] row-major).
//   In our case the PyTorch Linear weight is (Cout, Cin) row-major. That equals
//   W[Cin,Cout] col-major. Perfect: load matrix_b with col_major from the raw weight pointer.

__device__ __forceinline__ void mma_gemm_16x16xK(
    const __half* A, // [16, K] row-major in shared mem, stride = K (K = 32 or 128)
    const __half* B, // weight matrix, treated as (K x N) col-major, i.e. row-major (N x K)
    float* C_out,    // [16, N] in registers via fragment (we'll store to shared)
    __half* C_shared,// [16, N] row-major in shared mem to receive output
    int K, int N,
    int lane, int warp_id_local)
{
    // M=16, each warp computes one (16x16) tile in N dimension.
    // Number of N tiles = N/16. We have one warp per window; need to iterate tiles.
}

struct WinSmem {
    __half resid[N_TOK*DIM];      // 1024 B
    __half ln[N_TOK*DIM];          // 1024 B
    __half qkv[N_TOK*3*DIM];       // 3072 B (Q|K|V concatenated along col)
    __half attn[N_TOK*N_TOK];      // 512 B
    __half attno[N_TOK*DIM];       // 1024 B
    __half hidden[N_TOK*HIDDEN];   // 4096 B
};

// One warp (32 threads) per window. WINS_PER_BLOCK warps per block.
__global__ void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w,   // [96,32] row-major  (Cout=96, Cin=32)
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w,  // [32,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w,   // [128,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w,   // [32,128]
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int lane = threadIdx.x;  // 0..31

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln    = sm->ln;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;

    // Each lane loads one (token, halfpair) -> we have 16 tokens * 32 channels = 512 halves = 16 halves per lane
    // Use float4 (8 halves) per load -> 2 float4 per lane = 16 halves.
    // Map: each lane handles one token in two passes? Better: 16 tokens, 4 chunks of 8 channels per token.
    // total chunks = 16*4 = 64, so 2 chunks per lane.
    // chunk index = lane*2 + i (i=0,1)
    // token = chunk/4, c_base = (chunk%4)*8
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    unsigned mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    // LayerNorm 1: each lane handles 0.5 token (16 tokens, 32 lanes -> 2 lanes per token)
    // Each pair of lanes (lane%2) handles one token, split into halves.
    // Simpler: each lane handles one token using 16 lanes; other 16 lanes idle?
    // We'll do: lane in [0,15] -> token = lane, full 32 channels per token.
    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM]);
        float sum = 0.f, sumsq = 0.f;
        float vs[DIM];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
            float2 v = __half22float2(row[k]);
            vs[2*k] = v.x; vs[2*k+1] = v.y;
            sum += v.x + v.y;
        }
        float mean = sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float d = vs[k] - mean;
            sumsq += d * d;
        }
        float invstd = rsqrtf(sumsq * (1.0f/(float)DIM) + 1e-5f);
        s_mean[wlocal][tok] = mean;
        s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[k]);
            float out = (vs[k] - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln[tok * DIM + k] = __float2half(out);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ===== QKV GEMM via WMMA =====
    // Y[16,96] = X[16,32] @ W[32,96]  (W from qkv_w[96,32] viewed as col-major -> [32,96] col-major == [96,32] row-major)
    // Use 16x16x16 tiles. M=16(tokens), K=32, N=96. K tiles = 2, N tiles = 6.
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag0, a_frag1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag0, b_frag1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c_frag;

        // Load A (X) tiles - two K tiles
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag0, sh_ln + 0, DIM);   // cols [0,16)
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);  // cols [16,32)

        // For each N tile (6 of them):
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            // B[K,N] tile col-major: we view qkv_w as (N=96, K=32) row-major
            // col_major view: B(k,n) at qkv_w[n*32 + k]
            // tile (k_tile=0, n_tile=nt): start at n=nt*16, k=0
            // base pointer for col-major load with leading dim = 32 (K)
            const __half* b_ptr0 = qkv_w + (nt * 16) * 32 + 0;
            const __half* b_ptr1 = qkv_w + (nt * 16) * 32 + 16;
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag0, b_ptr0, 32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag1, b_ptr1, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag0, b_frag0, c_frag);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag1, b_frag1, c_frag);
            // Store to sh_qkv: layout [16, 96] row-major, stride 96
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(reinterpret_cast<float*>(sh_attno) /*temp*/, c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            // Actually we need __half output. Convert: each lane writes part.
            // Use a small fp32 scratch and convert.
            __syncwarp();
            // Convert 16x16 fp32 tile in sh_attno scratch to fp16 in sh_qkv at column offset nt*16
            // sh_attno scratch reinterpret as float[16*16] = 256 floats = 512 halves = whole sh_attno (16*16=256 halves only)
            // That's not enough. Use a dedicated fp32 scratch in shared.
        }
    }
    // The above approach has issues with scratch space; redo with proper fp32 scratch.

    __syncthreads();
}

// Rewrite cleanly:
__global__ void swin_block_kernel_v2(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w,   // [96,32] row-major
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w,  // [32,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w,   // [128,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w,   // [32,128]
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int lane = threadIdx.x;

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln    = sm->ln;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;     // 16 x 96
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;    // 16 x 16
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;   // 16 x 32
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;  // 16 x 128

    // fp32 scratch for WMMA store (16x16 floats = 1024 bytes), one per window
    // Place it after all WinSmem blocks
    __shared__ float scratch_fp32[WINS_PER_BLOCK][16*16];
    float* sscratch = scratch_fp32[wlocal];

    // Load input window into sh_resid
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    // LN1
    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        float vs[DIM];
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            vs[k] = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + k]);
            sum += vs[k];
        }
        float mean = sum / (float)DIM;
        float sq = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) { float d = vs[k]-mean; sq += d*d; }
        float invstd = rsqrtf(sq/(float)DIM + 1e-5f);
        s_mean[wlocal][tok] = mean;
        s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[k]);
            sh_ln[tok*DIM + k] = __float2half((vs[k]-mean)*invstd*w + bb);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ===== QKV: Y[16,96] = X[16,32] @ W^T where W is [96,32] -> equivalent to using col_major B from W
    // M=16, K=32, N=96 ; tiles: K=2, N=6
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_ln + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            const __half* bp0 = qkv_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0;
            const __half* bp1 = qkv_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16;
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, bp0, 32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, bp1, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            // copy 16x16 fp32 -> sh_qkv[:, nt*16:(nt+1)*16], add bias
            // 256 elements, 32 lanes -> 8 per lane
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_qkv_b[oc]);
                sh_qkv[r * (3*DIM) + oc] = __float2half(val);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== Attention: A[16,16] = (Q * scale) @ K^T + rpe, softmax, then attn@V
    // Q at sh_qkv[:, 0:32], K at sh_qkv[:, 32:64], V at sh_qkv[:, 64:96]
    // Use WMMA for QK^T: M=16, K=32, N=16. Q is row_major [16,32]; K^T means we want K as col_major from sh_qkv's K block.
    // K is stored row-major [16,32] within sh_qkv stride 96. So K^T col-major view with leading dim = 96.
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> qa0, qa1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> kb0, kb1;
        // matrix_b row_major with K^T means we treat K as B where B is K^T:
        // Actually for D = Q @ K^T, B = K^T (K x N). K stored row-major [16,32] with stride 96.
        // K^T has shape [32,16]; element K^T[k,n] = K[n,k]. In memory col-major of K^T means
        // contiguous in k -> same as K row-major rows. Use col_major B with ld = 96.
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> kb0c, kb1c;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(qa0, sh_qkv + 0,  3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(qa1, sh_qkv + 16, 3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(kb0c, sh_qkv + 32 + 0,  3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(kb1c, sh_qkv + 32 + 16, 3*DIM);

        wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
        wmma::mma_sync(c, qa0, kb0c, c);
        wmma::mma_sync(c, qa1, kb1c, c);
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
        __syncwarp();

        float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)DIM);
        // softmax row-wise; one lane per row (16 active)
        if (lane < N_TOK) {
            int i = lane;
            float vals[N_TOK];
            float mx = -CUDART_INF_F;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                vals[j] = sscratch[i*16 + j] * scale + __half2float(c_rpe_bias[i*N_TOK + j]);
                mx = fmaxf(mx, vals[j]);
            }
            float s = 0.f;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) { vals[j] = __expf(vals[j]-mx); s += vals[j]; }
            float inv_s = 1.0f / s;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                sh_attn[i*N_TOK + j] = __float2half(vals[j] * inv_s);
            }
        }
        __syncwarp();
    }

    // ===== attn @ V: O[16,32] = A[16,16] @ V[16,32], V in sh_qkv at col 64, stride 96
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a, sh_attn, N_TOK);

        // Two N tiles for the 32-wide output
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, sh_qkv + 64 + nt*16, 3*DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a, b0, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                sh_attno[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(sscratch[r*16 + col]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== proj: P[16,32] = attno[16,32] @ proj_w^T, proj_w [32,32]
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_attno + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_attno + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, proj_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0,  32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, proj_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_proj_b[oc]);
                float resid = __half2float(sh_resid[r*DIM + oc]);
                sh_resid[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(val + resid);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== LN2
    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        float vs[DIM];
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            vs[k] = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + k]);
            sum += vs[k];
        }
        float mean = sum / (float)DIM;
        float sq = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) { float d = vs[k]-mean; sq += d*d; }
        float invstd = rsqrtf(sq/(float)DIM + 1e-5f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float w = __half2float(c_norm2_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm2_b[k]);
            sh_ln[tok*DIM + k] = __float2half((vs[k]-mean)*invstd*w + bb);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ===== FC1: H[16,128] = LN[16,32] @ fc1_w^T, fc1_w [128,32]
    // M=16, K=32, N=128 ; K tiles=2, N tiles=8
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_ln + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, fc1_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0,  32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, fc1_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_fc1_b[oc]);
                sh_hidden[r*HIDDEN + oc] = __float2half(gelu(val));
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== FC2: O[16,32] = H[16,128] @ fc2_w^T, fc2_w [32,128]
    // M=16, K=128, N=32 ; K tiles=8, N tiles=2
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a[8];
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a[kt], sh_hidden + kt*16, HIDDEN);
        }

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b, fc2_w + (nt*16)*128 + kt*16, 128);
                wmma::mma_sync(c, a[kt], b, c);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_fc2_b[oc]);
                float resid = __half2float(sh_resid[r*DIM + oc]);
                sh_resid[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(val + resid);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== Write output
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        __half* o_ptr = x_out + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(o_ptr + c_base) = v;
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    const __half* norm1_w, const __half* norm1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* norm2_w, const __half* norm2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    __half* out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_w, norm1_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_b, norm1_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_b, qkv_b, 3*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_b, proj_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);

__device__ inline float gelu(float x) {
    return 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erff(x * 0.7071067811865475f));
}

__constant__ __half c_norm1_w[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_norm1_b[DIM];
__constant__ __half c_qkv_b[3*DIM];
__constant__ __half c_proj_b[DIM];

// We'll keep weight matrices in global memory and load via WMMA fragments.
// For best WMMA layout we'll store:
//   qkv_w as (3*DIM=96 rows, DIM=32 cols) row-major  -> we want C_out x C_in
//   For WMMA we need 16x16x16 tiles. We'll transpose-treat as needed.

//   We compute Y[16,Cout] = X[16,Cin] @ W[Cin,Cout]
//   Using wmma::fragment<matrix_a, 16,16,16, half, row_major> for X (M x K)
//   Using wmma::fragment<matrix_b, 16,16,16, half, col_major> for W^T view, or row_major.
//   We'll store weights as col_major (i.e., W[Cin,Cout] in col-major == W^T[Cout,Cin] row-major).
//   In our case the PyTorch Linear weight is (Cout, Cin) row-major. That equals
//   W[Cin,Cout] col-major. Perfect: load matrix_b with col_major from the raw weight pointer.

__device__ __forceinline__ void mma_gemm_16x16xK(
    const __half* A, // [16, K] row-major in shared mem, stride = K (K = 32 or 128)
    const __half* B, // weight matrix, treated as (K x N) col-major, i.e. row-major (N x K)
    float* C_out,    // [16, N] in registers via fragment (we'll store to shared)
    __half* C_shared,// [16, N] row-major in shared mem to receive output
    int K, int N,
    int lane, int warp_id_local)
{
    // M=16, each warp computes one (16x16) tile in N dimension.
    // Number of N tiles = N/16. We have one warp per window; need to iterate tiles.
}

struct WinSmem {
    __half resid[N_TOK*DIM];      // 1024 B
    __half ln[N_TOK*DIM];          // 1024 B
    __half qkv[N_TOK*3*DIM];       // 3072 B (Q|K|V concatenated along col)
    __half attn[N_TOK*N_TOK];      // 512 B
    __half attno[N_TOK*DIM];       // 1024 B
    __half hidden[N_TOK*HIDDEN];   // 4096 B
};

// One warp (32 threads) per window. WINS_PER_BLOCK warps per block.
__global__ void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w,   // [96,32] row-major  (Cout=96, Cin=32)
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w,  // [32,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w,   // [128,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w,   // [32,128]
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int lane = threadIdx.x;  // 0..31

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln    = sm->ln;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;

    // Each lane loads one (token, halfpair) -> we have 16 tokens * 32 channels = 512 halves = 16 halves per lane
    // Use float4 (8 halves) per load -> 2 float4 per lane = 16 halves.
    // Map: each lane handles one token in two passes? Better: 16 tokens, 4 chunks of 8 channels per token.
    // total chunks = 16*4 = 64, so 2 chunks per lane.
    // chunk index = lane*2 + i (i=0,1)
    // token = chunk/4, c_base = (chunk%4)*8
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    unsigned mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    // LayerNorm 1: each lane handles 0.5 token (16 tokens, 32 lanes -> 2 lanes per token)
    // Each pair of lanes (lane%2) handles one token, split into halves.
    // Simpler: each lane handles one token using 16 lanes; other 16 lanes idle?
    // We'll do: lane in [0,15] -> token = lane, full 32 channels per token.
    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        const __half2* row = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM]);
        float sum = 0.f, sumsq = 0.f;
        float vs[DIM];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM/2; k++) {
            float2 v = __half22float2(row[k]);
            vs[2*k] = v.x; vs[2*k+1] = v.y;
            sum += v.x + v.y;
        }
        float mean = sum * (1.0f/(float)DIM);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float d = vs[k] - mean;
            sumsq += d * d;
        }

        s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;

            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[k]);
            float out = (vs[k] - mean) * invstd * w + bb;
            sh_ln[tok * DIM + k] = __float2half(out);

    __syncwarp();

    // Y[16,96] = X[16,32] @ W[32,96]  (W from qkv_w[96,32] viewed as col-major -> [32,96] col-major == [96,32] row-major)
    // Use 16x16x16 tiles. M=16(tokens), K=32, N=96. K tiles = 2, N tiles = 6.
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag0, a_frag1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag0, b_frag1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c_frag;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);  // cols [16,32)

            // col_major view: B(k,n) at qkv_w[n*32 + k]
            // tile (k_tile=0, n_tile=nt): start at n=nt*16, k=0
            // base pointer for col-major load with leading dim = 32 (K)
            const __half* b_ptr0 = qkv_w + (nt * 16) * 32 + 0;
            const __half* b_ptr1 = qkv_w + (nt * 16) * 32 + 16;
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag0, b_ptr0, 32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag1, b_ptr1, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag0, b_frag0, c_frag);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag1, b_frag1, c_frag);
            // Store to sh_qkv: layout [16, 96] row-major, stride 96
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(reinterpret_cast<float*>(sh_attno) /*temp*/, c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            // Actually we need __half output. Convert: each lane writes part.
            // Use a small fp32 scratch and convert.
            __syncwarp();
            // Convert 16x16 fp32 tile in sh_attno scratch to fp16 in sh_qkv at column offset nt*16
            // sh_attno scratch reinterpret as float[16*16] = 256 floats = 512 halves = whole sh_attno (16*16=256 halves only)
            // That's not enough. Use a dedicated fp32 scratch in shared.
        }
    }
    // The above approach has issues with scratch space; redo with proper fp32 scratch.

    __syncthreads();

// Rewrite cleanly:
__global__ void swin_block_kernel_v2(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w,   // [96,32] row-major
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w,  // [32,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w,   // [128,32]
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w,   // [32,128]
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    int nH, int nW)
{
    int wlocal = threadIdx.y;
    int win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_BLOCK + wlocal;
    int total_windows = B * nH * nW;
    if (win_id >= total_windows) return;

    int total_per_b = nH * nW;
    int b = win_id / total_per_b;
    int rem = win_id % total_per_b;
    int wh = rem / nW;
    int ww = rem % nW;

    int lane = threadIdx.x;

    extern __shared__ __half smem_all[];
    WinSmem* sm = reinterpret_cast<WinSmem*>(smem_all) + wlocal;

    __half* sh_resid = sm->resid;
    __half* sh_ln    = sm->ln;
    __half* sh_qkv   = sm->qkv;     // 16 x 96
    __half* sh_attn  = sm->attn;    // 16 x 16
    __half* sh_attno = sm->attno;   // 16 x 32
    __half* sh_hidden= sm->hidden;  // 16 x 128

    // fp32 scratch for WMMA store (16x16 floats = 1024 bytes), one per window
    // Place it after all WinSmem blocks
    __shared__ float scratch_fp32[WINS_PER_BLOCK][16*16];
    float* sscratch = scratch_fp32[wlocal];

    // Load input window into sh_resid
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        const __half* x_ptr = x_in + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(x_ptr + c_base);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]) = v;
    }
    __syncwarp();

    __shared__ float s_mean[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];
    __shared__ float s_invstd[WINS_PER_BLOCK][N_TOK];

    // LN1
    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        float vs[DIM];
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            vs[k] = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + k]);
            sum += vs[k];
        }
        float mean = sum / (float)DIM;
        float sq = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) { float d = vs[k]-mean; sq += d*d; }
        float invstd = rsqrtf(sq/(float)DIM + 1e-5f);
        s_mean[wlocal][tok] = mean;
        s_invstd[wlocal][tok] = invstd;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float w = __half2float(c_norm1_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm1_b[k]);
            sh_ln[tok*DIM + k] = __float2half((vs[k]-mean)*invstd*w + bb);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ===== QKV: Y[16,96] = X[16,32] @ W^T where W is [96,32] -> equivalent to using col_major B from W
    // M=16, K=32, N=96 ; tiles: K=2, N=6
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_ln + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            const __half* bp0 = qkv_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0;
            const __half* bp1 = qkv_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16;
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, bp0, 32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, bp1, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            // copy 16x16 fp32 -> sh_qkv[:, nt*16:(nt+1)*16], add bias
            // 256 elements, 32 lanes -> 8 per lane
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_qkv_b[oc]);
                sh_qkv[r * (3*DIM) + oc] = __float2half(val);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== Attention: A[16,16] = (Q * scale) @ K^T + rpe, softmax, then attn@V
    // Q at sh_qkv[:, 0:32], K at sh_qkv[:, 32:64], V at sh_qkv[:, 64:96]
    // Use WMMA for QK^T: M=16, K=32, N=16. Q is row_major [16,32]; K^T means we want K as col_major from sh_qkv's K block.
    // K is stored row-major [16,32] within sh_qkv stride 96. So K^T col-major view with leading dim = 96.
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> qa0, qa1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> kb0, kb1;
        // matrix_b row_major with K^T means we treat K as B where B is K^T:
        // Actually for D = Q @ K^T, B = K^T (K x N). K stored row-major [16,32] with stride 96.
        // K^T has shape [32,16]; element K^T[k,n] = K[n,k]. In memory col-major of K^T means
        // contiguous in k -> same as K row-major rows. Use col_major B with ld = 96.
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> kb0c, kb1c;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(qa0, sh_qkv + 0,  3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(qa1, sh_qkv + 16, 3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(kb0c, sh_qkv + 32 + 0,  3*DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(kb1c, sh_qkv + 32 + 16, 3*DIM);

        wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
        wmma::mma_sync(c, qa0, kb0c, c);
        wmma::mma_sync(c, qa1, kb1c, c);
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
        __syncwarp();

        float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)DIM);
        // softmax row-wise; one lane per row (16 active)
        if (lane < N_TOK) {
            int i = lane;
            float vals[N_TOK];
            float mx = -CUDART_INF_F;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                vals[j] = sscratch[i*16 + j] * scale + __half2float(c_rpe_bias[i*N_TOK + j]);
                mx = fmaxf(mx, vals[j]);
            }
            float s = 0.f;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) { vals[j] = __expf(vals[j]-mx); s += vals[j]; }
            float inv_s = 1.0f / s;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int j = 0; j < N_TOK; j++) {
                sh_attn[i*N_TOK + j] = __float2half(vals[j] * inv_s);
            }
        }
        __syncwarp();
    }

    // ===== attn @ V: O[16,32] = A[16,16] @ V[16,32], V in sh_qkv at col 64, stride 96
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a, sh_attn, N_TOK);

        // Two N tiles for the 32-wide output
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, sh_qkv + 64 + nt*16, 3*DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a, b0, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                sh_attno[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(sscratch[r*16 + col]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== proj: P[16,32] = attno[16,32] @ proj_w^T, proj_w [32,32]
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_attno + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_attno + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, proj_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0,  32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, proj_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_proj_b[oc]);
                float resid = __half2float(sh_resid[r*DIM + oc]);
                sh_resid[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(val + resid);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== LN2
    if (lane < N_TOK) {
        int tok = lane;
        float vs[DIM];
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            vs[k] = __half2float(sh_resid[tok * DIM + k]);
            sum += vs[k];
        }
        float mean = sum / (float)DIM;
        float sq = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) { float d = vs[k]-mean; sq += d*d; }
        float invstd = rsqrtf(sq/(float)DIM + 1e-5f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int k = 0; k < DIM; k++) {
            float w = __half2float(c_norm2_w[k]);
            float bb = __half2float(c_norm2_b[k]);
            sh_ln[tok*DIM + k] = __float2half((vs[k]-mean)*invstd*w + bb);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ===== FC1: H[16,128] = LN[16,32] @ fc1_w^T, fc1_w [128,32]
    // M=16, K=32, N=128 ; K tiles=2, N tiles=8
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a0, a1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b0, b1;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a0, sh_ln + 0,  DIM);
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a1, sh_ln + 16, DIM);

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b0, fc1_w + (nt*16)*32 + 0,  32);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b1, fc1_w + (nt*16)*32 + 16, 32);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a0, b0, c);
            wmma::mma_sync(c, a1, b1, c);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_fc1_b[oc]);
                sh_hidden[r*HIDDEN + oc] = __float2half(gelu(val));
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== FC2: O[16,32] = H[16,128] @ fc2_w^T, fc2_w [32,128]
    // M=16, K=128, N=32 ; K tiles=8, N tiles=2
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::row_major> a[8];
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16,16,16, __half, wmma::col_major> b;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16,16,16, float> c;

        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a[kt], sh_hidden + kt*16, HIDDEN);
        }

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fill_fragment(c, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b, fc2_w + (nt*16)*128 + kt*16, 128);
                wmma::mma_sync(c, a[kt], b, c);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(sscratch, c, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) {
                int idx = lane * 8 + e;
                int r = idx / 16;
                int col = idx % 16;
                int oc = nt*16 + col;
                float val = sscratch[r*16 + col] + __half2float(c_fc2_b[oc]);
                float resid = __half2float(sh_resid[r*DIM + oc]);
                sh_resid[r*DIM + oc] = __float2half(val + resid);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ===== Write output
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int chunk = lane * 2 + i;
        int tok = chunk >> 2;
        int c_base = (chunk & 3) * 8;
        int h_idx = wh * WH + (tok >> 2);
        int w_idx = ww * WW + (tok & 3);
        __half* o_ptr = x_out + ((b * H + h_idx) * W + w_idx) * C;
        float4 v = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(&sh_resid[tok * DIM + c_base]);
        *reinterpret_cast<float4*>(o_ptr + c_base) = v;
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    const __half* norm1_w, const __half* norm1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* norm2_w, const __half* norm2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    __half* out,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_w, norm1_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm1_b, norm1_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_qkv_b, qkv_b, 3*DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_proj_b, proj_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_w, norm2_w, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_norm2_b, norm2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc1_b, fc1_b, HIDDEN*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_fc2_b, fc2_b, DIM*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbolAsync(c_rpe_bias, rpe_bias, N_TOK*N_TOK*sizeof(__half), 0, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream);

    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = B * nH * nW;
    int num_blocks = (num_windows + WINS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WINS_PER_BLOCK;

    dim3 grid(num_blocks);
    dim3 block(32, WINS_PER_BLOCK);

    size_t smem_bytes = WINS_PER_BLOCK * sizeof(WinSmem);

    swin_block_kernel_v2<<<grid, block, smem_bytes, stream>>>(
        x, out, qkv_w, proj_w, fc1_w, fc2_w, B, H, W, C, nH, nW);
}
